data.main_html:
survivoR now includes US50 and AU12

Posted on May 27, 2026 by Daniel Oehm in R bloggers | 0 Comments

[This article was first published on R Archives - Dan Oehm | Gradient Descending, and kindly contributed to R-bloggers]. (You can report issue about the content on this page here)
Want to share your content on R-bloggers? click here if you have a blog, or here if you don't.

After a couple of big seasons survivoR v2.3.12 has been updated with US50 and AU12.

Get it on:

  • Github
  • XLSX download
  • JSON endpoints

As of writing, the survivoR package is closing in on 30,000 downloads, which is wild to me. Not only that, but the CRAN installs are probably the lowest volume of all formats. Installs directly from Git and the XLSX downloads are probably much higher. I never thought this data would be so popular.

I don’t have much of a social media presence, pretty much only Bluesky these days, and a very small following there. Regardless many people reach out to say thanks for pulling it together. It has enabled them to build their own websites (of which there are quite a few – Survivor-reference, survivorELO), be used for research papers, Master theses, school projects, help potential castaways with their Survivor auditions, help future Survivor players prep for their season, even then Survivordle web app.

I enjoy hearing about how others are utilizing it. If you have experience with it as well, please reach out—I am always keen to discuss Survivor!
